newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X active as investors place bets.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X active as investors place bets.

text.p: Bre-X Minerals Ltd led actives on the Toronto Stock Exchange at midday on Thursday as investors bet on the fate of Bre-X's huge Busang gold deposit in Indonesia.
Shares in the Calgary-based exploration company rose 0.20 to 24.65 on more than 1.8 million shares.
Investors were buying or selling shares depending on whether they believed a bid from Placer Dome Inc to merge with Bre-X would be acknowledged by the Indonesian government, traders said.
"Some people believe. Some people don't," one trader said.

On Tuesday, Placer Dome announced a US$5 billion merger offer for Bre-X, saying it sensed the Indonesian government might be willing to consider arrangements for Busang besides a joint-venture being negotiated by Barrick Gold Corp.

Indonesia's Mines Minister Ida Bagus Sudjana had a meeting with President Suharto in Jakarta on Thursday. Analysts said they expected Busang was the major topic of conversation but Sudjana avoided commenting to journalists.
Neither Bre-X, Barrick nor Placer Dome have had any response from Indonesian officials yet, spokesmen for all three companies said Thursday.
"We have no news, I'm afraid," Placer Dome spokesman Hugh Leggatt said in Vancouver.

A Mines Ministry official told Reuters in Jakarta last week that Indonesia would reply to Bre-X and Barrick by the end of this week at the latest. However, that was before Placer Dome made its proposal public.
